explanation: The statement is an inequality relating the genus of a Laurent-series base change of the Γ1(Mp) q-expansion function field, the genus of the Igusa function field over X1(M), and the number of places above supersingular j-invariants. It is written entirely in the library's own definitions: genusFF, igusaFunctionFieldX1C, x1FunctionFieldC, ssJSet, laurentBaseChange. Grepping Mathlib for genusFF, igusaFunctionFieldX1C and ssJSet found nothing. The proof combines several library-specific results with a Riemann–Hurwitz estimate for Kummer extensions and an index/cusp-count computation, so no single Mathlib declaration gives it.
